s: An Error Item is any item whose internal ID doesn't exist in the game's item data. Error items have no associated item data and thus default to purchase/sell prices of 0g, descriptions reading "???", and a placeholder 🛇 sprite.
There are no known ways to produce an Error Item in the latest versions of the base game. However, they can occur due to mods.
